image_model_note: Pinned 2026-10-06 by the owner after the Phase 0 style test (Build Log 02): the most Saturday-morning-cartoon look and the most readable sprites. assets.notes: Phase 0 pipeline proof: 5-view turnaround -> cutout rig (blender/render_walk.py) -> 8 directions x 8-frame walk. Needs art QA before final.
Primitive stand-in from blender/make_standin_turnaround.py, for pipeline tests

5-view turnaround (art/prompts/character_turnaround.txt, 16:9) -> make sprite -> 8 directions x 8-frame walk, 192 px cells. The rig normalises every figure to the same cell height: size it in game with DirectionalSprite height_units. Human fighter (party). Tabard snaps to rust/brown under the palette. Needs art QA before final.

5-view turnaround (art/prompts/character_turnaround.txt, 16:9) -> make sprite -> 8 directions x 8-frame walk, 192 px cells. The rig normalises every figure to the same cell height: size it in game with DirectionalSprite height_units. Halfling rogue (party). Drawn alone, so he fills the cell like a human: use about half a human's height_units. Needs art QA before final.

5-view turnaround (art/prompts/character_turnaround.txt, 16:9) -> make sprite -> 8 directions x 8-frame walk, 192 px cells. The rig normalises every figure to the same cell height: size it in game with DirectionalSprite height_units. Dwarf cleric (party). Sheet had touching shield/mace silhouettes; split by the new connected-component pass in blender/lib/cutout.py. Use a smaller height_units than humans. Needs art QA before final.

5-view turnaround (art/prompts/character_turnaround.txt, 16:9) -> make sprite -> 8 directions x 8-frame walk, 192 px cells. The rig normalises every figure to the same cell height: size it in game with DirectionalSprite height_units. High elf wizard (party). Staff below the hips is kept rigid by the new prop pass (cutout.split_props); robe hem still swings with the legs. Needs art QA before final.

5-view turnaround (art/prompts/character_turnaround.txt, 16:9) -> make sprite -> 8 directions x 8-frame walk, 192 px cells. The rig normalises every figure to the same cell height: size it in game with DirectionalSprite height_units. Barovian villager zombie (enemy). Hunched pose survives the rig. Needs art QA before final.

5-view quadruped turnaround (21:9) -> blender/render_walk.py --static -> 8 directions x 1 still frame, 192 px cells, same walk_<dir>/idle_<dir> names as walk sheets (the game adds the bob). Height fill 1.00 (tallest view fills the standard band). Grey wolf: the grey fur snaps to pale bone/pewter under the palette. Needs art QA before final.

5-view quadruped turnaround (21:9) -> blender/render_walk.py --static -> 8 directions x 1 still frame, 192 px cells, same walk_<dir>/idle_<dir> names as walk sheets (the game adds the bob). Height fill 1.00 (tallest view fills the standard band). Large dire wolf, second generation (first came out maroon, not black). Use a bigger height_units than the wolf. Needs art QA before final.
